portfolio.perf_empty: Performance builds from daily snapshots — today's value is saved on each sync. The chart appears once you have two or more days of history.
portfolio.no_holdings: No holdings yet — connect a wallet or add a transaction.
portfolio.no_txns: No transactions yet. Balances are synced; full Solana transaction history (used for cost basis and realized P&L) imports in the background and may take a few minutes. EVM addresses show balances only — add transactions manually if needed.
portfolio.empty: No portfolio yet. Create one, then connect a wallet or add a transaction.
portfolio.confirm_delete: Delete this portfolio and all its private data (holdings, transactions, snapshots, AI memory)? This cannot be undone.
portfolio.market_unavailable: Market pricing unavailable until exchange market data is initialized.
portfolio.intel_prompt: Generate grounded, easy-to-understand context on what changed, what is driving it, signal exposure, and risks — based only on your real holdings and market data.
portfolio.alerts_hint: Set price, value and risk alerts on your holdings.
portfolio.evm_note: Balances only — EVM transaction history is a follow-up.
portfolio.remove_keep_history: Keep this source's historical transactions? OK = deactivate (keep history); Cancel = delete everything from this source.
portfolio.safety: Investor Intel is read-only. We never request transactions, swaps, approvals, or your private keys. Connecting a wallet shares only your public address.
portfolio.disclaimer: Portfolio calculations are informational only and are not tax, accounting, investment, or financial advice. Cost basis and P&L may be incomplete when transaction history is missing, unclassified, or manually edited.

states.cost_basis_pending: Cost basis and P&L are pending until your transaction history imports. Solana history imports automatically in the background (this can take a few minutes after connecting); for EVM or exchange holdings, add transactions manually.
